query:
SELECT id, product, milestone_name, milestone_type, milestone_date
FROM milestones
WHERE milestone_type = 'pdp_gates'
AND (
  product LIKE '%Paloma2%'
  OR (product LIKE '%RBM2%Refresh%' AND milestone_name LIKE '%Product Commit%')
  OR (product LIKE '%RBM2 Refresh%')
);
